package observer_test

import (
	"fmt"
	"github.com/portpowered/infinite-you/pkg/platform/baselineobservation"
	"time"
)

type artifactIdentity struct {
	SourceCommit          string `json:"sourceCommit"`
	OverlayManifestSHA256 string `json:"overlayManifestSHA256"`
	ToolSourceCommit      string `json:"toolSourceCommit"`
	TestArtifactSHA256    string `json:"testArtifactSHA256"`
	GoVersion             string `json:"goVersion"`
	BuildCommand          string `json:"buildCommand"`
	Race                  bool   `json:"race"`
}

type ownerDiscovery struct {
	Kind            string   `json:"kind"`
	Status          string   `json:"status"`
	OwnerIdentities []string `json:"ownerIdentities"`
	Provenance      string   `json:"provenance"`
}
type resourceTotals struct {
	HandleCount          int `json:"handleCount"`
	LeaseRecordCount     int `json:"leaseRecordCount"`
	CapacityHoldersTotal int `json:"capacityHoldersTotal"`
}
type checkpointReport struct {
	Checkpoint             string                              `json:"checkpoint"`
	Timestamp              string                              `json:"timestamp"`
	FixtureScope           string                              `json:"fixtureScope"`
	FactorySessionID       *string                             `json:"factorySessionID"`
	RuntimeGenerationIDs   []string                            `json:"runtimeGenerationIDs"`
	Artifact               artifactIdentity                    `json:"artifact"`
	Owners                 []baselineobservation.OwnerSnapshot `json:"owners"`
	OwnerInventoryComplete bool                                `json:"ownerInventoryComplete"`
	LiveGoroutines         int                                 `json:"liveGoroutines"`
	Barriers               []string                            `json:"barriers"`
	Findings               []string                            `json:"findings"`
	OwnerDiscovery         []ownerDiscovery                    `json:"ownerDiscovery"`
	Totals                 resourceTotals                      `json:"totals"`
	BootstrapSessionIDs    []string                            `json:"bootstrapSessionIDs"`
}

func validateOwner(owner baselineobservation.OwnerSnapshot) (resourceTotals, error) {
	totals := resourceTotals{}
	if owner.OwnerIdentity == "" || owner.Source == "" {
		return totals, fmt.Errorf("missing owner attribution")
	}
	switch owner.Kind {
	case "instance_host":
		if owner.Host == nil || owner.Leases != nil || owner.Host.HandleCount != len(owner.Host.Handles) {
			return totals, fmt.Errorf("incomplete handle snapshot")
		}
		for _, entry := range owner.Host.Handles {
			if entry.Key == "" || entry.HandleIdentity == "" {
				return totals, fmt.Errorf("missing physical handle identity")
			}
		}
		totals.HandleCount = owner.Host.HandleCount
	case "models_leases":
		if owner.Leases == nil || owner.Host != nil || owner.Leases.CapacityHolders == nil || owner.Leases.LeaseRecordCount != len(owner.Leases.LeaseRecords) {
			return totals, fmt.Errorf("incomplete lease snapshot")
		}
		for key, count := range owner.Leases.CapacityHolders {
			if key == "" || count < 0 {
				return totals, fmt.Errorf("invalid holder count")
			}
			totals.CapacityHoldersTotal += count
		}
		if totals.CapacityHoldersTotal != owner.Leases.CapacityHoldersTotal {
			return totals, fmt.Errorf("incorrect holder sum")
		}
		for _, record := range owner.Leases.LeaseRecords {
			if record.Key == "" || record.Scope == "" || record.ModelName == "" || (record.Status != "ACTIVE" && record.Status != "RELEASED" && record.Status != "EXPIRED") {
				return totals, fmt.Errorf("invalid retained lease record")
			}
		}
		totals.LeaseRecordCount = owner.Leases.LeaseRecordCount
	default:
		return totals, fmt.Errorf("unknown owner kind")
	}
	return totals, nil
}

func validateReport(report checkpointReport) error {
	if report.RuntimeGenerationIDs == nil || report.BootstrapSessionIDs == nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("runtimeGenerationIDs and bootstrapSessionIDs must be arrays")
	}
	if report.Checkpoint != "Q0" && report.Checkpoint != "Q1" && report.Checkpoint != "Q2" {
		return fmt.Errorf("unknown checkpoint")
	}
	if _, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, report.Timestamp); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if report.FixtureScope == "" || report.LiveGoroutines < 1 || len(report.Barriers) == 0 || !report.OwnerInventoryComplete {
		return fmt.Errorf("incomplete checkpoint barriers or inventory")
	}
	artifact := report.Artifact
	if artifact.SourceCommit == "" || artifact.ToolSourceCommit == "" || artifact.OverlayManifestSHA256 == "" || artifact.TestArtifactSHA256 == "" || artifact.GoVersion == "" || artifact.BuildCommand == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("missing artifact identity")
	}
	owners := map[string]string{}
	totals := resourceTotals{}
	for _, owner := range report.Owners {
		if _, exists := owners[owner.OwnerIdentity]; exists {
			return fmt.Errorf("duplicate owner")
		}
		value, err := validateOwner(owner)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		owners[owner.OwnerIdentity] = owner.Kind
		totals.HandleCount += value.HandleCount
		totals.LeaseRecordCount += value.LeaseRecordCount
		totals.CapacityHoldersTotal += value.CapacityHoldersTotal
	}
	if totals != report.Totals {
		return fmt.Errorf("incorrect report totals")
	}
	kinds := map[string]bool{}
	attributed := map[string]bool{}
	for _, discovery := range report.OwnerDiscovery {
		if kinds[discovery.Kind] || discovery.Provenance == "" || (discovery.Kind != "instance_host" && discovery.Kind != "models_leases") {
			return fmt.Errorf("invalid owner discovery")
		}
		kinds[discovery.Kind] = true
		switch discovery.Status {
		case "registered":
			if len(discovery.OwnerIdentities) == 0 {
				return fmt.Errorf("missing registered owner")
			}
			for _, identity := range discovery.OwnerIdentities {
				if owners[identity] != discovery.Kind || attributed[identity] {
					return fmt.Errorf("unattributed owner")
				}
				attributed[identity] = true
			}
		case "not_created":
			if len(discovery.OwnerIdentities) != 0 {
				return fmt.Errorf("not-created owner has identities")
			}
		default:
			return fmt.Errorf("owner unavailable")
		}
	}
	if len(kinds) != 2 || len(attributed) != len(owners) {
		return fmt.Errorf("incomplete owner discovery")
	}
	return nil
}
